title: show-me: stop once the question is answered
author: bendrucker
body:
Adds one instruction to the Scope section of `show-me`: end the reply once the question is answered, and hold unrequested observations until the user asks.

With the skill loaded, replies drew the right visual and then closed on a survey nobody asked for: stubs, latent bugs, open decisions, an offer to build it. The Scope section said what to keep in the visual but not where to stop.

#### Hypothesis

- Target: `short-close` (prose after the last block under 500 characters) rises on the with arm of `request-flow`, `upload-pipeline`, `plugin-loader-design`, `settings-page`, `save-dedupe`, and `file-roles`.
- Guards: each case's survival graders (`failure-path`, `status-return`, `discovery`, `billing-condition`, `billing-subtree`, `keeps-watchers`, `covers-files`) and format graders hold.

#### Result

Starred rows from `compare.ts --markdown`, `dev` tag, four runs per case per column, both columns regraded against the suite's current graders:

| Row | Baseline | Candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tag score dev/with | 0.88 | 0.99* |
| Case score `request-flow/with` | 0.75 | 1.00* |
| `request-flow/with` · `short-close` | 0.00 | 1.00* |
| Reply words `save-dedupe/with` | 266 | 147* |
| Reply words `transport-split/with` | 250 | 169* |
| Reply words `plugin-loader-design/with` | 366 | 295* |
| Reply words `file-roles/with` | 208 | 161* |

`short-close` reached 1.00 on every dev case with the skill, up from 0.25 to 0.75 on the others, each short of a star at four runs. The survival graders held. `upload-pipeline/with` · `no-invented-trigger` fell from 1.00 to 0.75 unstarred: one run drew S3 triggering the worker, a factual slip the stop instruction does not touch. The without arm held flat (0.69 to 0.65), and the skill fired on every with-arm run in both columns.

Holdout, run once at the end with the skill at the suite commit against this branch: 0.90 to 0.92 with the skill, 0.71 to 0.67 without.
